pages.title: Binary Mergers
pages.text: $(thing)Binary Mergers$()$(br2)Two compact stars in orbit radiate gravitational waves, spiral in, and merge in a final whoop of rising pitch. Their chirp mass sets how fast. Unlocks gravitational-wave echoes - and an answer from the Frontier.

$(thing)Insight$(): 230$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Gravitational Waves, Kilonovae.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Chirp Signal Record, 1 Merger Remnant, 2 Black Hole Merger Record.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Two masses m and n spiral together. Their gravitational waves depend on one combination of the two, which sets how fast the pitch rises. Write it, M.
